summary: The AI coding assistants space is anchored by well-funded leaders such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, which set the pace on capability and distribution. A wave of earlier-stage challengers — including Zed, Continue — competes on focused differentiation and specific customer segments. The main axes of competition are product depth, integration into existing developer and buyer workflows, and go-to-market motion. White space remains around underserved verticals and workflows the incumbents treat as secondary. (This summary is generated from sample data — verify before citing.)
